OnlyKey is manufactured in the United States and is unusual in the FIDO key world for putting six physical buttons on the device. The buttons are used for on device PIN entry, which means the PIN does not pass through the host computer at all. The OnlyKey can hold static passwords, generate TOTP and HOTP codes, sign with PGP and SSH keys, and act as a FIDO2 and U2F authenticator. FIDO2 certification was completed relatively recently. The OnlyKey DUO adds a USB-C connector alongside USB-A in a more compact body.
